means: One scripted command that gathers what a step needs from the host in a single call, replacing many model exploring turns.
The host is data and a command asks it a question; the model gets the answer, not the path of exploring it.
The model states intent in words; policy tags pick a fixed command, so the model generates no parameters.
How a command's output is trimmed and formatted, set by command type and its single-purpose params; names before metadata.
A terse label a small model says in place of a command; the alias carries the params and the tidy-up.
A keyed holder of a deferred result: a fixed query collects the state of an undetermined target; a goal fans out into buckets.
A turn pre-filled as slot-like sentences bound to labels and data, so a router picks references by fuzzy position; fields, not UI slots.
An external label on an item picked or important, kept beside the turns; the most recent label picks the variant.
Who may call a helper: only the harness (depth one); a helper never drives another helper.
Each step goes to the cheapest actor able to do it: code, then query, then small model, then the main model.
How much aid (aliases, routes, partial turns, markers) a session gets; set per model and recorded, like influence mode.

name: collector replaces exploring turns
claim: A collector script that answers a step's question from the host in one call replaces the listing and reading turns a model would spend, at equal outcome and fewer requests (INTAKE C1, term cchwyx; related wmzdrt inventory, klsrrk select then fetch, rabacn host file tools, uvgdji graft; fault fhjphb redundant reads).

name: intent routing to a fixed command
claim: A model that states intent in words, mapped by policy tags to a fixed command, matches one that writes the command and its params, with fewer failed calls and output tokens (INTAKE C2; distinct from ilyhcw flow router and umepbc handler: it routes at the command, not the flow; tags uwgdqn, seam contracts ijihvc).

name: result shaping by command type
claim: A command's result shaped by its type and single-responsibility params returns only pertinent items (names before metadata), cutting later reads and tokens without losing the answer (INTAKE C3; related klsrrk, vtpcxq query shape, ijihvc return payload shapes; profile-side twin: term jgyfik argument summary).

name: command alias carries params and tidy-up
claim: A terse alias that carries its params and tidy-up lets a small model call a command with fewer made-up or malformed arguments than full syntax (INTAKE C4; related qvmztp handles, hzzgju ambiguous markers; fault hqvmzk made-up handle).

name: buckets as deferred keyed state
claim: Results held as keyed deferred state in buckets, filled by fixed queries with a goal fanning out into buckets, let a model address undetermined state without carrying it in context (INTAKE C5; related zsfqyi concern queue, gxxncg stems, qvmztp handles, term remjvg has/has-not view).

name: partial turns routed by fuzzy position
claim: A turn pre-filled as slot-like sentences bound to labels and data lets a router pick references by fuzzy string position, with no field text generated by the main model (INTAKE C6; related lyayzn turn templates, umepbc semantic-entry handler, hzzgju, qblgkn warp materialization).

name: passive markers resolved by recency
claim: External labels on picked or important items, where the most recent label picks the variant, keep references right across drift and renames and cut hallucinated references (INTAKE C7; related uwgdqn tags beside turns, zlnvtx identity by checksum, hzzgju in-prefix twin; fault hqvmzk).

name: harness-driven helper at depth one
claim: A helper called only by the harness, never by another helper, writes the passive markers and tags that steer the main model, within one cent per operation (INTAKE C8; narrows tampqj flow alteration by the depth rule; related pppezv, term szatwd tag foundry).

name: cheapest actor first
claim: Giving each step to the cheapest actor able to do it (code, query, small model, main model) lowers cost at equal outcome (INTAKE C9, derived from C1, C2, C8; related pppezv, uvgdji graft, vifitn, nlavpp).

name: scaffold degree differs per model
claim: The scaffold that helps (aliases, routes, partial turns, markers) differs per model, so each is a per-model setting with a recorded degree and a strong model may need none (INTAKE C9; related term thfqaz influence mode, rhaenk natural steering, ltqbmi voice degree).
